about: Rows the server's Zetaris (Lightning 2.4.3.1) returned for Dalil's fixed open-data queries, copied from the data column of stored answers in the evaluation stores of 22, 24 and 26 October 2026 (build/dalil-eval*.db and build/dalil.db in the release dalil-preservation-2026-11-19). Only the SQL and the rows are kept: they are Bayanat open data. No question text or answer is copied. The complaints query is the one in use before 25 November 2026; it is kept to compare engines on the same statement.

recorded.sql: SELECT year, transactions FROM dalil.open_icp_transactions WHERE service_en = 'Renewal of ID Card' ORDER BY year DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Year AS year, CAST(SUM(CAST(SolvedComplaints_count AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT) AS solved FROM dalil.open_mohre_solved_complaints GROUP BY Year ORDER BY Year DESC LIMIT 1
